text:
ian: Noticing a p99 tailwave of 502s for hosted inference in euw1 starting ~6359130000. Customer escalation incoming, saw spike ~10:12 UTC. Dashboard p99 jumped from 180ms -> 2.2s and 502 fraction up to 6%.

maria: saw the alert. SLO burn from 0.3% -> 2.8% in last 15m. Linking dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/euw1/ingress-slo?from=6359129000&to=6359132600 :eyes:

ajay: any recent deploys or config changes?

ian: no deploys logged for infer-gateway. But ops pushed a rate-limiter config at 6359128001 (internal ticket #OPS-424). Could be related.

sre-bot: probe alert: INGRESS_P99_SLO_BURN euw1 severity=high triggered at 6359132100.

maria: tracing gaps on these traces. Many requests don't have spans past gateway. Likely upstream handshake timeouts. Query I ran (loki):
```
{job="ingress"} |= "handshake timeout" | json | count_over_time(1m)
```
result: spike aligned with 502s.

ajay: also seeing authz errors 401 followed by immediate 502s for same trace ids. Could be token rotation hitting a cache miss pattern.

katie: customer said they saw "temporary server error" in client logs, then retries. Which client? Hosted inference public API.

support-bot: Customer #C-1029 reported 502s at 10:13 UTC with request ids: r_9f8a... r_3c2b...

ian: trying to repro with curl against prod gateway with same headers. Sample curl: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Region: euw1" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello"}'
```
I get 200 most of the time, but 1/15 attempts returns 502 with "upstream handshake timeout".

maria: can you paste the gateway logs for one of the failing request ids?

ian: pasted logs: 
```
[6359132121] request=r_9f8a path=/v1/generate auth=ok route=ingress-euw1 upstream_connect_time=1203ms error="handshake timeout to backend: read deadline"
```

ajay: that upstream_connect_time looks like it hit the backend batcher. Are batcher nodes showing OOM/restarts?

katie: I checked k8s for batcher-euw1: a couple of pods had RestartCount increment at ~6359129500 due to file descriptor leak in v2.3.7. But those were restarted and came healthy.

maria: maybe combined effect: rate-limiter config tightened concurrency -> more connections to fewer backends -> handshake timeouts when batcher briefly overloaded. We should correlate rate-limiter token buckets. Query: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM ingress_conn_log WHERE region='euw1' AND status='502' AND ts > 6359129000
```
(not a real SQL, just pseudo).

ian: also noticed KV-cache miss ratio spiked (kvcache_evicts up). Could be cache TTL mismatch after token rotation. If gateway can't use cached auth, it spins extra calls to auth service -> latency.

sre-bot: Auth service latency SLO: p95 went 40ms -> 480ms around same window.

ajay: root cause hypothesis: ops rate-limiter change reduced tolerated concurrency, pushing more requests to single batcher pods while auth token rotation caused cache churn -> backend handshake timeouts -> 502s.

katie: mitigation options: 1) roll back rate-limiter change, 2) expand batcher pool temporarily, 3) add short-circuit fallback to retry on 502 with jitter for public API (but that's app-level).

maria: immediate action: add a short-term autoscale bump for batcher-euw1. I'll open a hotfix: K8s Scale batcher-euw1 replicas +3.

ian: I'll add an alert rule to catch handshake-timeout spike earlier: increase sampling for handshake log and trigger at 0.5% 10m.

ajay: I'll check auth token rotation schedule and whether the rotation coincided with cache TTL values. If TTL lower than expected, bump TTL to reduce churn.

support-bot: Notified customer #C-1029 that we're investigating and applying temporary mitigation.

katie: after scale up, 502 fraction dropped to 0.6% in last 3m. Reopen if it climbs.

maria: follow-ups: - postmortem once stable, track OPS-424 change for rollback window; - add synthetic probe to catch handshake timeouts; - correlate restart counts with handshake errors.

ian: assigning owners: ops -> ajay, infra -> maria, oncall -> ian. I'll create a thread in postmortems channel when we have RCA. :white_check_mark:

ajay: one more note — add trace sampling for failing requests so we can preserve spans for longer (trace retention) during incidents.

maria: ack. thanks all.
